retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic 1990s-style layout featuring a warm-toned romantic portrait overlaid with vibrant neon script and geometric shapes.
triggerTerms: neon pink script over sepia photo

recipe.visualDefinition: A sepia-toned or desaturated photograph of a couple in an embrace on a beach, featuring a prominent top-left logo composed of fluid neon-pink script layered over a cyan geometric triangle, with a vertical list of names in a classic serif font on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant neon typography contrasting against a muted, warm-toned photographic background
Geometric triangle shape acting as a bridge between the script and the blocky secondary text
Vertical text alignment on the left balancing the central photographic subject
High-contrast black clothing on the subjects providing a focal point for the composition
coreInvariants: Warm, desaturated color palette for the photography
Fluid, expressive script for the primary title
Cyan and magenta/pink color accents in the graphic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A couple in a close embrace occupies the center and right-center of the frame, scaled to fill the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright pink script logo in the top-left corner serves as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left logo, down the vertical text list on the left, then across to the faces of the couple in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The open beach and sky on the right provide breathing room for the dense graphic elements on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and desaturated browns in the photography
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black in the clothing and shadows
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon magenta/pink and bright cyan in the graphic overlays
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphics against low saturation in the image creates a layered, collage-like effect.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to a 90s-specific cyan/magenta accent pair

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid cursive script and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script features long, sweeping ascenders and descenders with variable line weight
Secondary block text is heavily slanted (italicized) and condensed
Body text uses a traditional high-contrast serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'K' and 'l' in the script have exaggerated, looping flourishes
The block letters are sheared to the right for a sense of motion
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, colorful script paired with a sober, traditional serif for information.
graphicDevices: Cyan triangle background for the logo

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn 90s script feel
Provides the high-contrast serif look for the list

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A sepia-toned photograph of a young couple embracing on a beach under a cloudy sky, with the woman leaning against the man's chest. Include a cyan triangle in the upper left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large neon-pink cursive title over the triangle. Below the title, add a blocky, slanted sans-serif subtitle. On the lower left, add a vertical list of names in a small, black, all-caps serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the script color neon pink?
Is there a cyan triangle behind the main text?
Is the list of names vertically aligned on the left?

adjustableVariables: Spacing of the vertical name list
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between text and image
avoid: Primary colors like bright red or yellow

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script does not obscure the faces of the subjects.
Ensure the cyan triangle has a slight drop shadow or border to separate it from the photo.
Verify the vertical list is legible against the beach background.
Confirm the overall mood is romantic and nostalgic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated romantic portrait + neon script logo in top-left + vertical serif list on left.
